construction: The inherited journey remains the exact motion track but is not drawn. A single red point moves along it. Rooms accumulate only after the point enters them. The visible black structure contains a lattice edge only when every in-bounds room touching that edge has already been entered, so a visible room never closes itself against a neighboring room that is still invisible.
invariants: the inherited 64-state path as invisible computation
one red point at the exact eased path position
entered rooms accumulate and never disappear
every visible edge is bordered only by entered rooms
no visible spine, threshold fragment, room fill, surface, or butterfly form
changes: the open black edge structure derived from that set
camera orbit and rigid upward presentation

surface_contract.current: clear rooms and black lines only
surface_contract.frontier: an edge touching any unentered in-bounds room remains hidden
